axes.description: The explicit origin of a quality statement.

terms.description: Produced by a model-backed review agent.
Produced by a deterministic analysis tool.
Produced directly by a person.
Imported from an external or legacy source.
The producer cannot be established without inference.

axes.description: How completely applicable evidence was available.

terms.description: All expected applicable evidence was available.
Only part of the expected applicable evidence was available.
Applicable evidence could not be obtained.

axes.description: What the evidence establishes for a subject or aspect.

terms.description: The evaluated requirement is satisfied.
The evidence shows a concern without establishing failure.
The evaluated requirement is not satisfied.
The evidence cannot support a conclusive assessment.
The evaluated requirement does not apply to the subject.
No assessment has yet been performed.

axes.description: The direction of an observed before-and-after quality delta.

terms.description: Quality improved in the comparison.
Quality regressed in the comparison.
The comparison contains both improvements and regressions.
The evaluated quality is materially unchanged.
No quality-relevant delta was observed.
The direction of change cannot be established.

axes.description: A versioned policy disposition, separate from assessment.

terms.description: Policy permits the subject to proceed.
Policy permits the subject with a warning.
Policy prevents the subject from proceeding.
Policy defers disposition pending more information or authority.

axes.description: The ordered impact severity of a finding.

terms.description: Critical impact requiring immediate attention.
High impact requiring prompt attention.
Material impact that should be addressed.
Limited impact.
Informational quality context.

axes.description: The human or policy-managed state of a correlated issue.

terms.description: The issue is active and unresolved.
An authorized actor accepted the issue risk.
An authorized actor waived the applicable requirement.
The reported occurrence is not a valid issue.
The issue has been explicitly resolved.

axes.description: The semantic type of an evidence reference.

terms.description: Source code or a source location.
A test execution result.
A measurement captured from a running system.
Structured or textual output from a tool.
A persisted build, review, or analysis artifact.
A document or preserved textual statement.
An explicit statement made by a person.

aspects.title: Security
aspects.description: General security quality not assigned to a narrower aspect.

aspects.title: Input validation
aspects.description: Validation and safe processing of untrusted input.

aspects.title: Boundary exposure
aspects.description: Exposure and protection of externally reachable boundaries.

aspects.title: Business logic
aspects.description: Security properties of business workflows and invariants.

aspects.title: Attack coverage
aspects.description: Coverage of applicable attack types for exposed boundaries.

aspects.title: Performance
aspects.description: General runtime performance and resource efficiency.

aspects.title: Change risk
aspects.description: Quality risk introduced by a change.

aspects.title: Test evidence
aspects.description: Adequacy of test evidence for a change.

aspects.title: Scope discipline
aspects.description: Discipline and coherence of the delivered change scope.

aspects.title: Architecture drift
aspects.description: Architectural drift caused by a change.
